notes: Initial uncalibrated baseline. Units in original workbook are inferred: m/s, kW, kg/m3.
116.5 m hub height and 36 MW grid capacity are supported by Vena's project announcements; confirm current operating settings.
Availability=1, wind multipliers=1 and electrical losses=0 are assumptions, not fitted estimates.
Each optional directional multiplier list has 12 entries for sectors centered on 0,30,...,330 degrees (meteorological wind-from direction).
The two density tables in the uploaded workbook are identical; no density adjustment is applied.

snapshot_manifest.issue_time_definition: Time all required latest API responses had been retrieved; NWP run initializations are not supplied by these responses.

assumptions.status: Uncalibrated physical/weather ensemble; no SCADA training or empirical accuracy claim.
assumptions.target: Per-turbine generation potential and operation-conditioned power; farm grid export after scenario aggregation/cap.
assumptions.quantiles: Q10/Q50/Q90 are lower/median/upper CDF quantiles; raw weather spread, not validated prediction intervals or exceedance P-values.
assumptions.energy: hourly_energy_proxy_kwh assumes each instantaneous mapped power sample represents one hour; it is not metered energy.
assumptions.wind_height: API 100 m winds adjusted to 116.5 m with alpha=0.14. JMA uses 10 m and is benchmark only.
assumptions.density: Fixed reference curve at 1.225 kg/m3; original units inferred and density tables identical. No density correction.
assumptions.loss_assumptions: Availability=1, wind multipliers=1, electrical loss=0 by default; no calibrated wake/terrain/icing model.
assumptions.shutdown: 25.0 m/s generates per workbook; >25 shuts down; <=23 restarts if hysteresis enabled. Initial state running assumed.
assumptions.point_estimate: Mean of scenario power. Each family has equal weight, each complete member equal within family.
assumptions.spatial_dependence: Same family/member used simultaneously across every turbine. Sum scenarios, cap, then summarize.
assumptions.time: Stored in UTC, displayed in Asia/Tokyo; issue time is retrieval completion, not NWP run initialization.
assumptions.JMA availability: JMA MSM has a shorter horizon; benchmark may omit hours. It is excluded from ensemble weights.
